card: Adds functional test coverage in rpc_psbt.py for global PSBT field validation during decoding. It verifies rejection of invalid version numbers, fallback to version 0 when the version field is omitted, rejection of PSBTv2-only global fields in PSBTv0, and enforcement of mandatory input and output counts in PSBTv2. The author demonstrates that mutating global version bounds in psbt.h previously went undetected by the test suite.
changed_since_previous: Expanded coverage beyond global version parsing to also test rejection of PSBTv2-specific global fields in PSBTv0 and mandatory input and output count fields in PSBTv2.
evidence: Author demonstrates that mutating PSBT_HIGHEST_VERSION from 2 to 4 in src/psbt.h triggered no existing test failures (PR description)
Author links to previously uncovered global PSBT decoding error paths in src/psbt.h lines 1515-1556 (PR description)
problem: Multiple validation rules and error conditions in src/psbt.h for decoding PSBT global fields lacked test coverage. Regressions in version parsing or field compatibility between PSBTv0 and PSBTv2 could go undetected.

risk.why: Touches only functional test code for PSBT RPC testing.

summary: Adds functional test coverage in rpc_psbt.py for decoding and validating PSBT global fields. Tests verify rejection of unsupported version numbers (versions 1 and 3), fallback to version 0 when the version field is omitted, rejection of PSBTv2-only global fields present in a PSBTv0, and enforcement of mandatory input and output count fields in PSBTv2.
